llm.summary: The skill does what it says — it scrapes Sci‑Hub mirrors for a PDF URL given a DOI, and does not request extra credentials or install third‑party packages.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the implementation: the Python script queries a small list of Sci‑Hub mirrors, parses the HTML for PDF links, and returns a JSON result. Required binary (python3) is appropriate and nothing else is requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the provided script with a DOI and to use curl to download the returned URL. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, access secrets, or contact unexpected endpoints beyond the listed Sci‑Hub mirrors.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction + a small standalone Python script that uses only the standard library, so nothing is downloaded or installed at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The script performs unauthenticated HTTP requests only — requested privileges are minimal and proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent modifications to the agent environment or other skills' configs. It has normal, limited runtime behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent, but be aware of non-security considerations before using it: 1) It makes outbound HTTP(S) requests to third‑party Sci‑Hub mirrors — these are external network calls visible in logs and to your network operators. 2) Sci‑Hub links may point to hosts that serve malicious or malformed PDFs; only download and open files from sources you trust (consider sandboxing). 3) Depending on your jurisdiction or institutional policies, using Sci‑Hub may have legal or policy implications. 4) If you want extra caution, review the included Python script (it's small and uses only the standard library), run it in an isolated environment, and monitor network activity.
